headline: Media urged to follow court directives on Sheikh Hasina's statements
summary: The Press Information Department has issued a request to all media outlets and social media platforms to adhere to judicial instructions regarding the dissemination of the Prime Minister's remarks.
details: The Press Information Department (PID) of the Government of Bangladesh has issued a formal request to all mass media and social media platforms. This directive urges strict adherence to court instructions concerning the broadcasting and dissemination of statements made by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

The request, dated August 29, emphasizes the importance of upholding judicial orders in media reporting. It aims to ensure that all public communication regarding the Prime Minister's remarks aligns with legal guidelines.
This move by the PID highlights the government's intention to regulate the reporting of high-profile political statements. It underscores the legal framework governing media conduct in Bangladesh.

headline: 60 km/h storm expected by 9 AM in Dhaka and 13 other districts
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department has issued a warning for strong winds and rain across 14 central districts, including the capital. Residents are urged to prepare for potential disruptions.
details: A storm with wind speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour is forecast to hit Dhaka and 13 other districts by 9 AM. This warning comes from the Bangladesh Meteorological Department, urging residents to stay vigilant.
The affected districts are expected to experience strong gusts and accompanying rainfall. Such weather conditions can lead to temporary disruptions in daily life and transportation.
Authorities advise citizens in the warned areas to take necessary precautions. Securing loose objects and staying indoors during the peak of the storm are recommended for safety.
